feeds.title: Erasmus+ by Primera Blog
feeds.description: Primera is the European Centre of Teachers' Professional Development. We want to change the world for the better by empowering teachers, so they can do their job best. Our blogs empower them with anything they need, let it be communication skills, entrepreneurship skills, creativity, peer coaching, ICT, and so on, we believe we can reach more children than in any other way.

feeds.title: World Education Blog
feeds.description: The Global Education Monitoring Report (the GEM Report, formerly known as the Education for All Global Monitoring Report) is an editorially independent, authoritative and evidence-based annual report published by UNESCO. Its mandate is to monitor progress towards the education targets in the new Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) framework.

feeds.title: UCL Europe Blog » Research & Education
feeds.description: Academic comment and analysis on Brexit, run from the UCL European Institute. Here you will find European-focused academic analysis and commentary from UCL academics and external contributors. The wide range of blogs covers issues ranging from EU politics and climate change to philosophy, public health, and Brexit.

feeds.title: EERA Blog
feeds.description: The European Educational Research Association is an association of national and regional associations representing educational researchers in Europe. The aim of the 'European Educational Research Association (EERA) is to further high-quality educational research for the benefit of everyone.

feeds.title: European Schoolnet Academy Blog
feeds.description: Our courses offer you an introduction to innovative pedagogical concepts, whole-school strategies, and tools and resources which you can use in your daily teaching practice. They also allow you to reflect on your current practices, produce concrete outputs that you can use in your work, and engage with a large community of educators.

feeds.title: Teaching With Europeana
feeds.description: Teaching with Europeana is a blog created by teachers for teachers, helping you incorporate Europeana resources in your classroom. They are a network of 34 Ministries of Education in Europe. Their aim is to bring innovation in teaching and learning to our key stakeholders.

feeds.title: CleverBooks
feeds.description: CleverBooks sets the standards in Augmented Reality to help kids improve test-score by up to 33% and increases retention rate by up to 100% with the latest STEM-oriented Augmented Reality (AR) technology that supports students' individual learning styles. Go through their blog and learn more about them and read informative articles related to the European education system.

feeds.title: University Association for Contemporary European Studies
feeds.description: UACES (University Association for Contemporary European Studies) is the global membership organisation for academics, students and practitioners who are interested in all aspects of Europe and the European Union. Ideas on Europe is a blog hosting service that provides an independent forum for informed analysis, comment and debate.

feeds.title: Scientix Blog
feeds.description: Scientix is a project that promotes and supports a Europe-wide collaboration among STEM (science, technology, engineering, and maths) teachers, education researchers, policymakers, and other STEM education professionals. Their blog focuses on topics like the education system, environment awareness, student ethics, creative thinking in students, and more.

feeds.title: Europass Teacher Academy Blog
feeds.description: Europass Teacher Academy provides teachers with continuing education courses in innovative teaching methods within the framework of Erasmus+. In our blog! Here is all the info that might be useful for you, content about our courses and the experiences at Europass Teacher Academy.

feeds.title: Education In Prorgess Blog
feeds.description: Education InProgress promotes the internationalization of the training experiences, realized in mobility, which enhances skills twice: at a professional and personal level. They also conduct research, design, and training aimed at developing innovative methodologies and approaches that relate to the world of education & youth.

feeds.title: The PIE Blog
feeds.description: The PIE provides content, connections, and careers for global education professionals along with industry insight from professionals in international education. They deliver valuable news & insight, innovative events, and exceptional recruitment expertise for international education thought their informative blog.

feeds.title: European schools Blog
feeds.description: The European School Non-Discrimination Campaign (ESNDC) is a group of parents and their supporters who want to address discrimination in European schools. This blog is all about European schools and covers various aspects such as the reasons behind discrimination, how it happens, and when it occurs. The blog discusses both the good and bad things related to European schools, including the problems they face.

feeds.title: The Guild Blog
feeds.description: The Guild is a collaborative network of 21 research-led universities spread across 16 countries, united by a common dedication to excellence in research, education, and innovation throughout Europe. Since its establishment in 2016, The Guild has been deeply committed to pursuing excellence while upholding the values of truth-seeking and trust-building, serving as the bedrock of public life. The blog provided by The Guild serves as an open space for sharing diverse perspectives on European education systems.
